title: Model lists get less brittle
summary:
Model selection got more adaptable, text requests got more predictable, and image feeds got stricter filtering.

The image feed editor now fetches model options from the image API, so newly available models can appear without a frontend change. It also has a loading state and a fallback list if the request fails. Separately, the DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B entry was renamed to avoid colliding with the full DeepSeek R1 model.

POST text cache keys now use the entire request body, preventing requests with different parameters, such as seeds, from sharing a cached response. Most text models also gained a Llama 4-derived conversational prompt, while models with specialized prompts keep them.

The image service now marks feed events whose prompts match mature terms. Feed listeners filter those events alongside flagged content, and no longer accept `nsfw=true` to bypass filtering.

highlights.title: An adaptable model picker
highlights.text: The image feed editor fetches its model choices from the API, so new options can appear without a frontend update.
